candidates.claim: In `Dense.continuous_upperBounds`, the proof expands the definition of closure membership via `mem_closure_iff_frequently` and uses filter reasoning to show `i ≤ x`. This can be done more canonically using the lemma `upperBounds_closure` and monotonicity (`upperBounds_mono_set`) after applying `hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS`.

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem Dense.continuous_upperBounds {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ] {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    upperBounds (f '' S) = upperBounds (range f) := by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ fun _ => upperBounds_mono (Set.image_subset_range f S) le_rfl
  have : upperBounds (closure (f '' S)) ⊆ upperBounds (range f) :=
    upperBounds_mono_set (hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS)
  simpa [upperBounds_closure] using this

candidates.requested_change: Rewrite the first inclusion proof to avoid `mem_closure_iff_frequently`/`Frequently` reasoning by passing to `closure (f '' S)` and using `upperBounds_closure`.

candidates.claim: In `Dense.continuous_lowerBounds`, the proof uses `mem_closure_iff_frequently` plus filter reasoning to derive order inequalities from closure membership. This can be done in the canonical order-topology style using `lowerBounds_closure` and `lowerBounds_mono_set` together with `hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS`.

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem Dense.continuous_lowerBounds {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ] {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    lowerBounds (f '' S) = lowerBounds (range f) := by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ fun _ => lowerBounds_mono (Set.image_subset_range f S) le_rfl
  have : lowerBounds (closure (f '' S)) ⊆ lowerBounds (range f) :=
    lowerBounds_mono_set (hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS)
  simpa [lowerBounds_closure] using this

candidates.requested_change: Rewrite the first inclusion proof to avoid `mem_closure_iff_frequently`/`Frequently` reasoning by passing to `closure (f '' S)` and using `lowerBounds_closure`.
